en.headline: Compulsory cover extended to Hong Kong side of Huanggang Port
en.dek: The government said 45 insurers have agreed, at no extra premium, to extend motor and employees' compensation policies to the Hong Kong port area.
body: Compulsory motor insurance and employees' compensation cover will extend to the Hong Kong port area of Huanggang Port ahead of its opening on 12 October, the government said on Friday.

The Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau has signed a market agreement with 45 insurers, the government said. Existing policies written under the Motor Vehicles Insurance (Third Party Risks) Ordinance and the Employees' Compensation Ordinance will cover the Hong Kong port area without an extra premium. The agreement took effect on 31 July.

A bureau spokesman said the arrangement was meant to remove possible confusion before the port area opens, so that policyholders continue to meet compulsory insurance requirements while administrative burden on the parties involved stays lower. The government described the deal as a practical step for the public.
Officials said the approach is similar to the arrangement used when the Hong Kong port area of Shenzhen Bay Port opened in 2007. Huanggang Port is due to open at 6:30am on Monday.

zh.headline: 強制汽車及僱員補償保險擴至皇崗港方口岸區
zh.dek: 政府稱已與45間保險公司簽訂市場協議，現有強制性保單毋須加費即可覆蓋皇崗口岸港方口岸區。
body: 政府周五表示，為配合皇崗口岸本月12日正式開通，已與45間保險公司簽訂市場協議，把現有強制性汽車保險及僱員補償保險保單的保障範圍，擴展至皇崗口岸港方口岸區。
財經事務及庫務局與各保險公司簽訂的協議，涵蓋《汽車保險（第三者風險）條例》及《僱員補償條例》下的保單，生效日期為今年7月31日。保單持有人毋須繳付額外費用，地域界限便會包括港方口岸區。
財庫局發言人表示，在港方口岸區啟用前促成協議，是要先消除可能引起公眾混淆的情況，確保保單持有人持續符合強制性保險規定，同時減低持份者的行政負擔。政府形容這是務實便民的安排。
有關做法與2007年深圳灣口岸港方口岸區啟用時相近。皇崗口岸定於周一上午6時30分開通。
